cod_assessment.rationale: COD matches contractual IA date (Aug 31 2027). All major milestones cleared: IA signed Dec 2024, FIS approved Feb 2026, 6.9(1) met Dec 2025, $17.6M LC posted. Amendment 1 Apr 2026 changed inverter supplier (procurement active). Construction reportedly started 2026. In-Service date Dec 3, 2026 is 5 months away — TSP must complete Western Wind Switch by then; that is the critical path. 7 prior COD slips (2021-12-31 through 2027-08-31) show pattern of drift. Not in EIA-860M is a mild negative. With 8 months to reported COD from today (Jul 2026), Q3 2027 plausible if no further slips; Q4 2027 if minor delay.
